quote: In defense and aerospace, HPA is a leading supplier of RF products and compound semiconductor foundry and assembly services to the U.S. government, U.S. defense primes, U.S. allies and other customers.

We provide products to our largest end customer, Apple Inc. ("Apple"), through sales to multiple contract manufacturers, which in the aggregate accounted for 50% and 47% of total revenue in fiscal years 2026 and 2025, respectively.
Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. ("Samsung") accounted for 10% of total revenue in both fiscal years 2026 and 2025.
